title: Rutland - Wound and Ostomy RN
description:
Position: Rutland - Wound and Ostomy RN
Location: Brooklyn, NY
Pay Rate: $ 68/hr
Schedule: 6:45am - 3:00pm
 
Duties:
- Initiates communication with patient and family to determine individual needs of patients, families and significant others.
- Initiates communication with co-workers and colleagues in other disciplines and departments to share and exchange ideas and information about related activities and needs.
- Provides detailed patient education to patient and family members during inpatient stay and at the time of discharge following prescribed teaching plans.
- Responds effectively, both verbally and non-verbally, to communications from patients, families and significant others as well as subordinates, colleagues, department heads, supervisors, physicians, etc.
- The Wound and Ostomy registered nurse’s decisions and actions on behalf of patients are determined in an ethical manner.
-  Demonstrates sensitivity to the values of self and others.
- Involves patient/family in plan of care incorporating their cultural, spiritual and other belief systems.


Requirements:
• Ability to effectively communicate in English, both verbally and written.
Skills:
• Good interpersonal and communication skills
Physical Demands:
• Involves standing, walking, sitting, talking, hearing and bending.
• May include some repetitive motions.
• Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position without compromising patient care. 
• Bachelor’s Degree required and Master’s Degree in Nursing is preferred.
• Minimum of (2) years of experience preferred.
• NYS RN License; BCLS, Required in specialty areas.
• Wound and Ostomy Certification preferred.

title: IMC - Nurse Manager, Emergency Department
description:
Position: IMC - Nurse Manager, Emergency Department
Location: Brooklyn, NY
Pay Rate: $75/hr
Schedule:  8 Am - 4 pm
 
Duties:
-Nurse Manager Emergency Department assumes 24-hour responsibility for overall assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation of patient care.
-Nurse Manager Emergency Department responsibilities include oversight and direction for the emergency department, and accountability for planning, directing, leading and evaluating nursing care within the department.
-Foster an environment of collaboration and respect with all other healthcare team members.
-Weekend and holiday coverage as needed is also a responsibility of the role as Nurse Manager.
-Performs related duties as required.
Operational Performance
-Develops long-term unit staffing schedules and ensures adequate daily coverage in accordance with established staffing needs.
-Develops measures and monitors unit operational performance metrics inclusive, agency and overtime costs, vacancy and turnover rates.
-Oversees the daily workflow, staffing, orientation, training and development of employees within the department.
-Responsible for the ongoing quality/performance improvement processes related to the emergency department.
-Promote and support a collaborative team approach in providing care for all ED and trauma patients.
-Approach others in a tactful manner and treat others with respect and consideration.
-Support and interpret policies, procedures, and objectives of the hospital.
-Monitors customer satisfaction scores and implements plans to improve scores.
-Monitors patient volume, quality of care, and performance of staff to identify areas for improvement.
-Maintains a departmental dashboard that includes information and progress on people, service, quality, and leadership

Skills:
-Minimum of five (5) years nursing experience of management and/or supervisory in the Emergency Department.
-Demonstrates leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
-Ability to effectively communicate in English both verbally and in writing.
-Excellent creative skills, ideas to improve existing programs.
-Ability to determine appropriate action in complex situations.
-Ability to manage multiple and simultaneous responsibilities and to prioritize scheduling work.
-Ability to complete work assignments accurately and in a timely manner.
-Ability to handle difficult situations involving patients, physicians, or others in a professional manner.
-Services, processes, ideas that have an impact on this job and the department.
-Master’s Degree in Nursing.
-Current license to practice as a Registered Professional Nurse in New York State.
-BLS, ACLS, & PALS Preferred

title: Registered Dietician (000359)
description:
Position: Registered Dietician (000359)
Location: New York, NY
Pay Rate: $ 53/hr
Schedule: 9:00 AM-5:00 PM
 
Duties:
- Monitors patients for and provides education on food/drug interactions. Records food and drug interactions in the education section.
- Consults with physicians regarding appropriate diet modification.
-Screens and assesses patients in an accurate and timely manner based on levels of care; determines patients' nutritional needs and status and provides follow-up care.
-Interviews patients and/or their families to obtain history of food habits and preferences.
-Interprets pertinent laboratory, physical and social data in the medical record, as it applies to nutrition care.
-Provides nutrition education and records patient's diet and diet instructions and the patient's understanding of the diet in the education section.
-Modifies patient menus as needed.
 
Requirements:
 -Two (2) years of experience.
-Graduate from accredited college/university with a degree in Dietetics or Foods and Nutrition. 
-Master's degree.
-For post-acute locations, requirements New York State Certification, issued by the New York State Education Department (NYSED) as a “Dietitian-Nutritionist”.
-For Acute locations: Registration by the Commissions on Dietetic Registration (CDR) as a Registered Dietitian
Primary Source Verification - Required. 
-AHA BLS.
-  Under the Medicare and Medicaid Programs, Reform of Requirements for Long-Term Care Facilities, as outlined in Section 483.60 of Title 42 of the Code of Federal Regulations all newly-hired Dietitians, assigned to a Post-Acute Care (Long-Term Care) facility, are required to have New York State Certification, issued by the New York State Education Department (NYSED), as a “Dietitian-Nutritionist” at the time of hire.

title: Rutland - MDS Assessor
description:
Position: Rutland - MDS Assessor
Location: Brooklyn, NY
Pay Rate: $ 75/hr
Schedule: Mon - Fri / No Weekends / No Holidays 8:00am - 4:00pm or 8:30am - 4:30pm

 
Duties:
Responsible for the assessments and/or coordination of assessments of all residents and completion of MDS forms in accordance with State and Federal regulations and facility policies.
Job Responsibilities:
-Obtains The Necessary Information to Perform a Thorough and Accurate Assessment in the MDS Process.
-Review The Daily Census.
-Prepares Interim Schedules/ Significant Change for Medicaid and Medicare MDS Assessments Daily.
-Inputs Data for Medicaid and Medicare in American Health Care Systems from MDS Booklets.
-Prepares And Transmits MDS/PRI Files to DOH By Using IBM Dialer and Netscape Timely and Accurately.
-Pulls Quality Indicator Reports from State Software as Required.
-Files MDS Booklets on Residents’ Chart.
-Orders Supplies for MDS Office. Inputs All Data PRI Full House, Quarterly’s and Discharges.
-Distributes Reports to Leadership.
-Works Closely with Quality Improvement Department.
-Perform other related duties.
 
Requirements:
-Minimum five (5) years of experience in clinical nursing including two (2) years in performing MDS completion.
-Ability to work in surroundings with degrees of dust, noise, etc. without undue discomfort.
-Ability to hear, talk, walk, stand, bend and stretch.
-Ability to read, write and interpret documents.
-Ability to sit for long periods of time at desk to perform job functions.
-Ability to stand for long periods of time at required patient bedside and/or procedural areas.
-Ability to communicate effectively with patients and/or co-workers.
-May be required to operate and clean equipment.
-May be required to handle reasonably heavy weights across distances.
-May be required to handle/ assist in lifting patients onto/out of exam beds/procedure stations.
-Must be trained in and knowledgeable of all Kingsbrook/Rutland policies and procedures pertaining to hazardous waste and hazardous materials and maintain qualifications applicable to assigned work.
-Other: Knowledge of all codes and demonstrate understanding.
-Bachelors Degree in Nursing (BSN).
- Licensed Registered Nurse with NYS.
